mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, but the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their respective 3-month moving averages signal robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1300 and INDPRO > 100 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 320), a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 5.4) indicates stable monetary conditions that support equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails when CPIAUCSL < 320 and FEDFUNDS < 5.4, as evidenced by negative 20-day returns in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of total non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which sustains consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for PAYEMS level as a signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150000.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1350 units signal robust residential construction and consumer confidence, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1350, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 700000) indicates a tight labor market and healthy consumer spending, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE < 4.0 and RSAFS > 700000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 100 indicates a manufacturing expansion, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to strengthening supply chains and economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
